notes: • Operator: the to-do list is the main screen now, on the Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android. Every to-do is one card that keeps its place through all its phases: a short title with the phase and a progress bar, where it stands in one line, the next step, and details folded away. An agent's question and the Operator's decisions show on the card as buttons (the recommended one starred) with an answer field, a ready PR gets a Merge button, and chips filter what needs you, what's to merge, what runs and what's put off (Later). The Operator's chat moved into a bar at the bottom (on the phones the second tab, after To-dos). The Operator writes the cards itself, nudges stuck workspaces, has clear review comments worked off, waits for checks and closes workspaces after a merge; merging and product decisions stay with you.
